units.source_text: 源氏公子职位还是近卫中将[\[3\]](#part1331.html#m3)的时候，经常在宫中侍候皇上，难得回左大臣邸宅。

en.t: When Prince Genji still held the rank of Middle Captain of the Left Imperial Guards, he was often in attendance on the emperor at court and rarely returned to the Left Minister's residence.

units.source_text: 左大臣家的人都怀疑：莫非另有新欢？

en.t: Everyone in the Left Minister's household wondered whether he might have found a new love elsewhere.

units.source_text: 其实源氏公子的本性，不喜欢世间常见的那种一时冲动的色情行为；

en.t: In truth, it was not in Prince Genji's nature to enjoy the kind of impulsive affairs so common in the world.

units.source_text: 不幸而有一种癖好，偶尔发作，便违背本性，不顾遗恨无穷，而做出不应该有的行为来。

en.t: Unfortunately, he had a certain weakness, and when it occasionally overcame him, he acted against his own nature, heedless of the endless regret it would bring, and did things he should never have done.
